translations.web: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.
translations.bsb: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.
translations.kjv: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
translations.asv: Now even a first covenant had ordinances of divine service, and its sanctuary, a sanctuary of this world.
